name: act1_level_3
title: Act 1 → whole party level 3
task: Get every party member to level 3 as fast as you can (take the level-ups).
scored_by: Passed the first moment every party member is level 3 or higher (the lowest level in the party counts). How you do it is recorded (method attribution), never graded. The game time it took is reported next to it.
about: Sandbox (family 2): every party member reaches level 3, by any means the game allows (fights, quests, exploration, level-up screens); the method is reported, never graded. Gale starts a level behind, so the level-up screen is part of the job. Cap to be calibrated by one pilot run. Start save: Gale has a level-up to 2 pending (not taken) and Shadowheart starts 79 m away, 13.5 m below the party.

note.where: The Overgrown Ruins near the crash site, by the chapel entrance, out of combat, no dialogue open; Shadowheart is about 80 m away, below.
note.objective: Get every party member to level 3.

character.name: Tav
character.brief: A half-elf paladin (Oath of Devotion), once a Baldur's Gate city watch sergeant.
